meta.title: Valyo — What's it worth?
meta.description: Take a photo, get an estimate of what your items are worth.

home.title: What's it worth?
home.subtitle: Take a photo. Valyo identifies the item and estimates what it could be worth second-hand.
home.anyObject: Any object — if there isn't enough evidence to estimate it honestly, we'll tell you.
home.noInvention: No guessing games. Valyo always shows where its estimates come from and how confident it is.

room.title: Scan a room
room.subtitle: A garage, a bedroom, a storage space — frame it wide, Valyo will spot valuable items.
room.resultsTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No objects found} =1 {1 object found} other {# objects found}}
room.noItems: No identifiable item of value in this photo.
room.detailAnalyzing: Looking up a precise estimate for “{label}”…

scan.title: Photograph your item
scan.subtitle: Any object — frame it fully, with good lighting.
scan.analyzing3: Still working — some items can take up to three minutes.
scan.skipFollowUp: Skip — see the result with current confidence
scan.rateLimited: Too many recent scans. Please wait a moment before trying again.
scan.analysisFailed: The analysis failed or took too long. Please try again.
scan.restart: Start over with a new photo

result.generalEstimateCaveat: Based on similar items, not on a search for this exact model — take it with a grain of salt.
result.noPriceText: No price available for this item — the references found weren't enough to give an honest estimate.
result.sourcesCaveat: Asking prices (listings) unless noted otherwise — never shown as confirmed sales without explicit proof. Date not guaranteed: these prices come from a web search and may not reflect today's market.
result.wrongObject: Wrong item, or something to add?
result.correctionLabel: Tell us what's off (e.g. “it's an Adidas, not a Nike”)

game.title: Guess the Price
game.intro: {count} real items, any kind of object. Guess their value — we'll tell you how close you got to our estimate.
game.guessPromptNew: What's this item worth brand new today, in {currency}?
game.guessPromptUsed: What's this item worth second-hand today, in {currency}?
game.notVerified: Estimate generated by our identification tool — not a verified official price.
